name: fmp_key_executives
description:
Key executives of one company from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): name, title and reported pay.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/key-executives as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, sent as given, e.g. AAPL).
For detailed pay by year use fmp_exec_compensation.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
